title: Lapse of TRICARE Select Facility Authorizations Under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select reaches the day after the last day of its validity span, it is closed as expired on that day under **Referrals and Authorizations**, and the days left on it are released.

The days a lapsed facility authorization releases are fixed only after every facility claim line billed under the authorization carries its use entry in the unit history.

## What the lapse records

- The authorization's status becomes expired, with the closing date given; its closing date is the day after its last span day.
- Its units remaining become zero.
- One release entry with the reason "expiration" is added to its unit history for the days released. Nothing else on the authorization changes.

## Invocation

The tool is `close_lapsed_authorization_515f616b`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the authorization whose span has ended, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup for the patient | identifier, as returned |
| `closed_date` | the date the authorization is closed as expired; it is also the date of the release entry | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `units_released` | the units released by the lapse, in the authorization's own unit of measure | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `release_entry_id` (the reference number of the new release entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization closed), `status` (reading "expired" once recorded), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `units_released` (the units released by the lapse).

## Points of reading

- A facility authorization whose last span day is 14 March (hypothetical) falls due for closing on 15 March, and 15 March is its closing date.
- The released days are a whole number of inpatient days and are never fewer than zero.
